_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Uyini Mbvumi {player_id}, u hlalekisa {num_rounds} swiringo swa Iterated Ultimatum Game.
U na ${pool} ku nyika swiringo leswi u nga si fanelanga na Mbvumi {other_id}.

Muvoneli:
  - Nyika tichabo: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Loko yi angarheliwa → U ta va na $(pool - X), loyi u ngana na yena a ta va na $X
  - Loko yi tikarhiwa → Vambirhi va ta va na $0
  - Kusuporta: [Offer: $3]  kana  'Ndzi tsakela leswi ngi swi vona. [Offer: $5]'

Muyingiseli:
  - Khongela eka tichabo hi [Accept] kana [Reject]
  - Kusuporta: 'Leswi ngi swi vona ku fana. [Accept]'
            'Ku tikukumuxa. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Swiringo {round_number} swi hlula! ---
Mbvumi {proposer_id} i mvoneli, Mbvumi {responder_id} i muyingiseli.
round.accepted: Mbvumi {responder_id} yi angarheliwe! Swiringo {round_number} swiendla: Mbvumi {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mbvumi {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Mavono lawa: Mbvumi 0: ${total_0}, Mbvumi 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mbvumi {responder_id} yi tikarhile tichabo! Swiringo {round_number} swiendla: Vambirhi va na +$0. Mavono ya kona: Mbvumi 0: ${total_0}, Mbvumi 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Muendli wa xikombelo u fanele ku endla xiringanyeto hi ndlela leyi [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ntsengo wa mali leyi u yi nyikelaka wu fanele ku va nhlayo ya kahle.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nxavo wu fanele ku va exikarhi ka $0 na ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: A ku na xiringanyeto lexi nga kona sweswi.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Muvoneli a fanele a [Accept] kana a [Reject] tichabo.

outcome.win: Mpiri {winner} u hlule hi $ {winner_total} ku tlula Mpiri {loser} loyi a hluriwa hi $ {loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Tintlangu leti ti hetelele hi ${total} loko ku hlanganisiwa.
